meaning:
1) to vomit up, spue out, disgorge
1a) (Qal) to vomit
1b) (Hiphil) to vomit up
1b1) of land spewing out its inhabitants (fig)
1b2) vomiting, disgorging

renderings.kjv: and he shall vomit them up again

elsewhere.note: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.
The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up, and lose your good words.
Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
